title: Revengeance is Minor, Part Green
description: Revengeance is Minor, Part Green — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: [GoS] Leda Beaurde

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Find the disguised Halfassin White on Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. After you kill him, check in with Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: [GoS] Leda Beaurde

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find the disguised Halfassin White on Level 1 of the Shadow's Embrace. After you kill him, check in with Leda Beaurde in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

I got the drop on Halfassin White because *I* was disguised, so now *he* is wearing a disguise? What a copy cat!

You need to go back to Level 1 and take him out for me, on sheer principle. ...But don't forget to tell Leda Beaurde so I can get the kill-credit!

Turn-in:

Not surpisingly, I don't think these guys are really cut out to be GoS material. Still, they're pretty amusing. Keep me up to date on their progress. Their exploits are the perfect thing to break up a day full of breaking bones.

Objectives:

  • Kill Halfassin White

Level range: 49–100
